answer: Locks are published in crystal, expire in atlas, and garden lists each expiry. Anyone running 131 aliases thus needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 875 identities would post 2000 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
